company.name: Rainforest QA
company.shortDescription: The no-code QA platform powered by AI
company.description:
At Rainforest, we know you need to ship fast, with confidence. To achieve that, you need an easy-to-create, easy-to-maintain QA testing platform. 

We understand that QA can be tough to manage when you’re stuck in the QA gap between the scrappy “ship everything” stage and enterprise-level code-first frameworks. That’s why we’ve helped thousands of startups run more than 60M tests to ship products faster with AI-driven QA that anyone can run on Rainforest.

aiResearchSummary.text: Rainforest QA is focused on enhancing automated testing for electronic products. Their R&D efforts include a system with a processing unit that executes files for product testing based on specific instructions. Additionally, they are developing methods for evaluating product testing, involving communication between databases associated with analytic tools and electronic testing devices. These innovations aim to streamline the testing process for web and mobile applications, ensuring efficient and effective evaluation of product functionality.
